en.title: 10 Must-Watch Movies Arriving on Streaming This November
en.summary: As the year winds down, a wave of exciting new films hits your favorite streaming platforms, offering everything from holiday cheer to serious Oscar contenders.
en.body:
## 1. Possible Love
Lee Chang-dong, the visionary director behind 'Burning' and 'Poetry,' returns with this highly anticipated drama. Premiering to critical acclaim at the Venice Film Festival, 'Possible Love' boasts an all-star Korean cast including Jeon Do-yeon and Sul Kyung-gu, making it a must-see for anyone following the international awards circuit. Its exploration of married life is already generating significant buzz.

## 2. Tony
While details are still emerging, 'Tony' is positioned as one of the standout original releases on Netflix this November. Its inclusion on Variety's list suggests a film with critical backing and potential for awards recognition, promising a compelling narrative that cinephiles will want to dissect.

## 3. Misty Green
This intriguing title is set to debut on Netflix, adding to the streamer's diverse November lineup. The inclusion of 'Misty Green' hints at a film that offers a unique perspective or a captivating story, making it a promising discovery for viewers looking beyond the obvious blockbusters.

## 4. Deck the Halls
Get ready for the holiday season as Netflix embraces the festive spirit with this original Christmas movie. If you're looking for heartwarming cheer and seasonal romance, 'Deck the Halls' is your go-to, promising a dose of yuletide joy perfect for cozy nights in.

## 5. One Year to Live, Buy a Man
This Japanese import is part of Netflix's international content push this November. Its unique title suggests a story with a blend of comedy and drama, offering a fresh narrative from a different cultural perspective that's sure to resonate with adventurous viewers.

## 6. Overacting
From Thailand, 'Overacting' is another international gem arriving on Netflix that promises to be a conversation starter. Its bold title could signify a film that plays with performance, genre, or expectations, offering a unique viewing experience.

## 7. Under Siege
This Colombian production lands on Netflix with an action-packed promise. 'Under Siege' is likely to deliver thrills and suspense, appealing to fans of high-stakes narratives and international crime thrillers looking for an adrenaline rush this month.

## 8. Unprotected: Murder in Galicia
For fans of true crime and gripping mysteries, this Spanish docu-series is a significant addition to Netflix's November slate. 'Unprotected: Murder in Galicia' delves into a real-life case, offering a deep dive into a complex investigation that will keep viewers on the edge of their seats.

## 9. The Good Lawyer
This French series enters the streaming fray, hinting at a sophisticated legal drama. 'The Good Lawyer' is expected to bring sharp dialogue and intricate plotting, appealing to audiences who appreciate well-crafted character studies and courtroom intrigue.

## 10. Terrace & T.O.
Prime Video adds 'Terrace & T.O.' to its growing library this November. While specific plot details are scarce, its inclusion suggests a film or series with a strong artistic vision or a compelling story that complements the platform's curated selection.
Bottom Line: This November's streaming releases offer a rich tapestry of global cinema and seasonal favorites, ensuring there's something compelling for every taste.
